decision_authority: #1895 current carry-forward frontier; fresh Production exact read 2026-10-07; U.S. Office of the Historian Burkina Faso (Upper Volta) recognition record; United Nations Security Council S/16696 (13 August 1984); current ATLAS same-identity official-name rules.

evidence.historical_decision: Republic of Upper Volta and Burkina Faso are successive official-name phases of the same sovereign state. U.S. diplomatic history states that the state's name changed from Upper Volta to Burkina Faso in 1984; the U.N. Security Council recorded official notification that the name of Upper Volta had been changed to Burkina Faso. The 4 August 1984 renaming therefore does not constitute state extinction or replacement.
evidence.rationale: The legacy model splits Thomas Sankara's single continuous presidency solely at the country-name boundary: 1983-08-04→1984-08-03 on Republic of Upper Volta and 1984-08-04→1987-10-15 on Burkina Faso. Retire the Upper-Volta-side fragment first with source transfer; a fresh exact-read correction will extend the Burkina Faso survivor back to Sankara's actual 1983-08-04 accession and preserve Republic of Upper Volta as a temporal official-name designation.
